name: US State Department Travel Advisories
tagline: Official US government travel advisory levels and country risk guidance
description: Official travel advisory data from the US Department of State, covering country-level risk levels (1–4), safety summaries, and related travel guidance for US citizens. Used by travel apps, risk platforms, and agents that need authoritative government advisory status rather than third-party risk scores.

auth.details: Public HTML/JSON endpoints; no API key required for published advisory feeds

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public government data; no published request quotas

example.response_snippet: Travel Advisories list with country names and Level 1–4 designations (HTML/JSON feed shape varies by endpoint)

use_cases: get current US travel advisory level for a country
list all countries currently at Level 3 or Level 4
summarize official safety guidance before trip planning
monitor advisory changes for traveler alert workflows
